en.summary: The 2026/27 budget of KSh 4.8 trillion follows the Bottom-Up Economic Transformation Agenda, putting farming, affordable housing, health, education and small firms first. Development spending for roads rose to KSh 176.9bn, and the key projects are the Rironi–Mau Summit highway (175 km, 30-year PPP) and the SGR extension to western Kenya. Regional project announcements are increasing ahead of the August 2027 election.
